summary: This is an 8-K (items 7.01 and 8.01) reporting routine monthly distributions, net asset value, portfolio metrics, and ongoing offering status. The registrant declared regular distributions (~$0.21 per share), disclosed its NAV ($23.90) as of April 30, 2026, and provided portfolio characteristics. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is involved. This is a standard periodic update for a closed-end fund or business development company. No deal terms apply.
